built_in_script.name: xiaohongshu-search
built_in_script.cause: The built-in script navigates directly to the legacy /search_result route and waits for navigation completion. The current site search flow uses /search_result_ai and stateful UI input.

custom_adapter.method: open Explore, close restored note overlay, type through the visible search control, enter the current search_result_ai route, then extract note cards

detail_test.observation: Current search_result_ai note anchors expose canonical /explore/{id} paths without xsec_token. Clicking the first card through automation reached the platform page-not-found/app-scan view.
detail_test.implication: Search discovery works, but detail retrieval requires a separately managed temporary access context or another approved detail path.
